relationships.subject: Licofelone
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment of rats with paclitaxel-induced mechanical allodynia with licofelone alleviated the allodynia in a time- and dose-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: AM630
relationships.evidence_quote: Both AM251 and AM630 significantly prevented the antiallodynic effects of IPM (Figure 3A) and licofelone (Figure 3B).

relationships.subject: Licofelone
relationships.evidence_quote: Molecular docking studies using the CB-Dock2 server revealed that licofelone binds to cavities in the CB1 and CB2 receptors with high affinity (−8.1 kcal/mol and −9.4 kcal/mol, respectively)

key_findings: Licofelone alleviated paclitaxel-induced mechanical allodynia in rats, blocked by CB1 and CB2 antagonists.
Docking suggests licofelone binds CB1 and CB2 in the same cavities as THC and WIN 55,212-2.
